statements.status_notes: No upstream fix is available: the advisory marks every 4.5.x release up to and including 4.5.25 as affected with no fixed version. vertx-core@4.5.14 is pulled transitively by druid-kubernetes-overlord-extensions via the Fabric8 Kubernetes client. Remediation requires upstream Eclipse Vert.x to ship a fix and Druid to repin. Monitor eclipse-vertx/vert.x and apache/druid upstream.
